text:
Incident Bot: PAGER: High error rate (502/504/5xx) observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2 starting ~04:12 UTC. Incident ID INC-2026-0421-01. Pager: SRE.
Kevin: ack, I'm on the pager. first look at apigw traces now.
Maya: i'm seeing a huge spike in kv-prefix cache misses and eviction churn across prefix-shard-07. miss rate went from 2% -> 48% in last 3m. correlates tightly with 502s.
Alex: taking operational lead for live mitigation. Kevin, can you paste the error samples?
Kevin: logs snippet: ```
2026-04-21T04:13:02Z ERROR gateway.go:312 upstream=prefix-cache shard=07 err=kv_read_timeout
2026-04-21T04:13:03Z WARN prefetcher.go:88 eviction=burst keys_evicted=12456 duration=12.3s
2026-04-21T04:13:04Z ERROR gateway.go:317 upstream=runtime err=upstream_502 status=502
```
Ben: infra dashboard shows cache worker pod restarts on node ip-10-2-7-44 around 04:10. OOMs? kube events show container OOMKilled on cache-worker-07.
Julia: confirming OOMKilled + liveness flaps. Prefetch queue backlog increased causing backpressure to KV RPCs -> timeouts -> gateway 502s.
Lee: support: customers A and B reported timeouts on completions, one filed a ticket mentioning intermittent 502s. I'm sending a proactive note to top-10 tenants.
Alex: immediate mitigation plan: 1) remove aggressive prefetching on shard-07 2) route traffic away from shard hot-hots 3) increase cache-worker memory limit as short-term 4) scale up replica count for prefix cache 5) enable fallback to cold storage for critical routes.
Maya: command to disable prefetch (internal): `POST /internal/cache/config -d '{"prefetch_enabled":false, "shards":["shard-07"]}'` — I can flip it now.
Kevin: do it. I'll open a temporary route rule to steer 30% of traffic to warm-fallthrough path.
Deploy Bot: Automated config roll: cfg-2026-04-21-evict-mitigation applied to prefix-service (by Maya).
Maya: `prefetch_enabled=false` applied for shard-07.
Ben: scaling cache-worker pool +2 replicas now: `kubectl scale deploy/cache-worker-07 --replicas=4`
Alex: routing change: add test rule to route 30% of /v1/generate to fallback cluster in us-west-2-fallthrough. Doing 10% -> 30% in 5m steps.
Kevin: watching metrics. error rate in gateway dropped from 18% -> 9% after disabling prefetch. latency for fallback path slightly higher but stable.
Julia: node that OOMed shows high RSS before kill. I'll bump memory limit and schedule a rolling restart for that daemonset once traffic is stable.
Lee: support update sent to impacted customers with mitigations and ETA for full recovery.
Emma: product: need to know customer impact window and affected tenants for postmortem and communications.
Kevin: current customer-impact list: tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-c (partial), internal test orgs. Approx 18 minutes of elevated errors before first mitigation.
Maya: dug into root cause signal: aggressive prefetch combined with hot-prefix fanout caused memory bloat in shard-07 worker; eviction algorithm misfired under high concurrency leading to a thundering eviction wave and subsequent KV RPC timeouts. Not typical checksum corruption, looks like eviction spike + backlog.
Alex: action items assigned:
- Kevin: continue routing adjustments and validate fallbacks (done -> monitor)
- Maya: open an ENG-RUN ticket to revisit prefetch heuristics and add backpressure (assigned)
- Ben: infra to increase mem and add pod anti-affinity to avoid co-locating heavy shards (in progress)
- Julia: schedule rolling restart and monitor for repeat OOMs (in progress)
- Lee: finalize customer communications and escalate to CS leads if more reach out (in progress)
Deploy Bot: Rolling restart initiated for cache-worker-07 (controlled, 1 pod at a time).
Kevin: live metrics show error rate down to 2.6% now, gateway 95th latency slightly up but acceptable. We should keep prefetch disabled until fix.
Maya: adding temporary metrics alert: if eviction_rate > 50k/min trigger auto-traffic-steer to fallthrough cluster.
Ben: increased memory limit on cache-worker from 2Gi -> 4Gi for shard-07, new pod came up healthy.
Alex: handoff plan: once error rate stable <1% for 20m, SRE will move incident to follow-up and close pager. Oncall for next 24h: Kevin remains primary, Alex secondary.
Lee: customer note updated with root-cause hypothesis: eviction surge due to prefetch + hot-prefix; mitigation applied and fallback enabled.
Emma: we'll schedule a postmortem with eng-runtime, infra, and SRE. Need timeline, RCA, and proposed changes to prefetch algorithm and eviction safeguards.
Maya: for RCA I'm saving heap profiles and eviction logs — will attach to ENG-RUN ticket.
Kevin: leaving a short runbook snippet here for next time: 
```
1) Disable prefetch on affected shard: POST /internal/cache/config ...
2) Steer traffic to fallthrough cluster via routing service
3) Scale cache-worker replicas and bump mem limits
4) Rolling restart of cache-worker daemonset
5) Notify customers and open postmortem
```
Julia: monitoring for a recurrence for another 40m. If any OOMs repeat, escalate to full pager.
Alex: confirmed stable. moving to 'post-incident' channel after 20m of stability. Thanks team. :heart:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-0421-01 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager closed for active paging; follow-up required.
